adjacency_construction.cell_id: C[a,b,c] with (a,b,c) the abstract net exponents of commuting unit transitions u,v,w; this ADJACENCY_INDEX is not the stored cell-coordinate triple under test
adjacency_construction.graph: Cayley graph of Z^3 with generators +/-u,+/-v,+/-w
adjacency_construction.inverse: each -axis transition exactly undoes the corresponding +axis transition
adjacency_construction.scope_note: This commuting-translation closure is the explicit W0 triaxial-grid construction needed for mixed-path recoalescence. With only six unlrelated labeled walk moves and no commutation relation, the universal-cover tree would leave the requested recoalescence/root audit underdetermined.
adjacency_construction.translation_homogeneity: A named direction has the same stored coordinate increment at every cell; this is stated explicitly rather than inferred from a guessed root law.

cell_coordinate_semantics.PRECOLLAPSE_ALGEBRAIC_VALUE: May be fractional or irrational; never stored as a cell address.
cell_coordinate_semantics.COLLAPSE_COMPLETION: Maps a precollapse value only to legal integer completion candidates; no lower/upper preference is assumed.
